title: Lateral blade packing predicts bacterial retention on reconstructed ball python scales: model and analysis code
description: Version 2.2.1 of the blade-array model and reproducibility package for the manuscript 'Lateral blade packing predicts bacterial retention on reconstructed ball python scales'. The archive includes the model implementation, analysis scripts, simulation-level CSV outputs, derived tables, manuscript figures and LaTeX sources. It covers the production ensemble, numerical verification, geometric and mechanistic Sobol analyses, the Sharklet AF comparison, alternative arrival formulations, independently varied species coefficients and the geometric control experiments (coverage-matched spacing, unmeasured relief factorial, fixed-density row phase and grid refinement).
